title: TELECUM #1

description.main: TELECUM #1 is the first issue of an erotic magazine from the Bogotá imprint grama/naipe, built around an afternoon in which a group of friends drew each other naked. Photographs by Faber Franco, drawings by the Club de Dibujo, texts on the scatological and a page of classified ads, directed by Juan Betancurth and David Ángel. 48 pages, Spanish, edition of 100.
description.extended:
TELECUM #1 is the first issue of an erotic magazine from the Bogotá imprint grama/naipe, built around an afternoon in which a group of friends drew each other naked.

The issue grew out of Juan Betancurth's invitation to the Club de Dibujo, whose members take turns as model and draughtsman. Its 48 pages open with Tómame, a photographic series by Faber Franco, and photographs of the sessions. The central texts circle the scatological. There are collective declarations on porn, the body and dirt, a reading of pentecostal eschatology from the anus, and a chronicle of an orgy in the mountains. A Club de Dibujo section gathers drawings by David Ángel, Diego Caro, Sebastián Fonseca, Ignacio Díaz and Camilo Monsalvo. Ángel adds Side Story, a graphic account of a trip into the countryside, and a page of real and invented classified ads closes the issue. Text in Spanish, published in August 2026 in an edition of 100.

Betancurth, born in Manizales, worked for years in Brooklyn and now lives in Bogotá. His sculpture, installation and performance draw on religious ritual, BDSM and domestic labour. He has shown at El Museo del Barrio, the Queens Museum, Performa and HKW Berlin. grama/naipe is the publishing and sound workshop of artist David Medina at Talleres Telecom, an artist-run space in Bogotá.
description.artist_bio: Juan Betancurth (b. Manizales, Colombia) makes sculpture, installation and performance concerned with ritual, power, submission and the semiotics of BDSM. Long based in Brooklyn, he now lives and works in Bogotá. His work has been shown at El Museo del Barrio, the Queens Museum, Performa, Fierman Gallery, MAMBO and HKW Berlin.

notes: Acquired from Printed Matter, New York: https://www.printedmatter.org/catalog/72148. Not signed. Issue 01, August 2026; first title in the erotic line of grama/naipe. Edition of 100. Offset, black and white and colour. Printed Matter stock 229106 C. Creative direction Juan Betancurth and David Ángel; editorial design David Ángel. Cover and central pages carry Tómame, a photographic series by Faber Franco.
